That change is not applied here."},{"name":"Eligibility criteria","found":true,"value":"12","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Schedule 1","quote":"A Receivable satisfies this Schedule 1 on a date of determination only if, on that date, each of the following is true.","note":"Schedule 1 lists criteria numbered 1 to 12. A Pool Receivable that fails any one criterion is excluded in full."},{"name":"Concentration limits","found":true,"value":"4","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Schedule 2","quote":"Receivables secured by used Financed Vehicles","note":"Unamended position. The four limits are: single state 20%, single Dealer 5%, original term over 72 months 25%, and used vehicles 70%. Amendment No. 1, Section 2(b), adds a fifth limit (FICO below 600: 35%) from 1 March 2026. That change is not applied here."},{"name":"Excess concentration treatment","found":true,"value":"Deducted from Eligible Pool Balance before Advance Rate","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 1.1 (definition of Borrowing Base)","quote":"(a) the Eligible Pool Balance less the Excess Concentration Amount, multiplied by (b) the Advance Rate then in effect","note":"The Schedule 2 percentages are measured against the Eligible Pool Balance before the excess is deducted (definition of Eligible Pool Balance). The limits are applied in the order listed, and an amount excluded under one limit is not counted again under a later limit (definition of Excess Concentration Amount)."},{"name":"Reserve amount","found":true,"value":"1% of the Eligible Pool Balance","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 1.1 (definition of Reserve Amount)","quote":"\"Reserve Amount\" means, on any date, an amount equal to 1% of the Eligible Pool Balance.","note":"The Reserve Amount is deducted after the Advance Rate is applied (clause (c) of the Borrowing Base definition). It is measured against the Eligible Pool Balance before deduction of the Excess Concentration Amount."},{"name":"Delinquency trigger","found":true,"value":"Three-period average Delinquency Ratio exceeds 6.0%","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 7.1","quote":"A \"Delinquency Trigger\" occurs if the average of the Delinquency Ratio for the three most recently ended Collection Periods exceeds 6.0%.","note":"The Delinquency Ratio uses Pool Receivables 60 or more days past due, excluding charged-off Defaulted Receivables. While the trigger continues, the Revolving Period is suspended. The lender's internal alert for 60+ day delinquency is set lower, at above 5%."},{"name":"Minimum tangible net worth covenant","found":true,"value":"US$40,000,000","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 6.12(a)","quote":"is not less than US$40,000,000","note":"Tested at the end of each fiscal quarter of the Parent. For this ratio only, up to US$15,000,000 of Subordinated Debt is added to Tangible Net Worth and deducted from Total Liabilities (Section 6.12(c))."},{"name":"Minimum liquidity covenant","found":true,"value":"US$10,000,000","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 6.12(d)","quote":"Liquidity at all times is not less than US$10,000,000, tested at the end of each calendar month.","note":null},{"name":"Restricted jurisdictions","found":false,"value":"","source_document":"","clause":"","quote":"","note":"Restricted Jurisdiction is defined as each jurisdiction listed in Schedule 4. The list could not be extracted."},{"name":"Margin","found":true,"value":"3.25%","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 2.6(a)","quote":"plus 3.25% (the \"Margin\")","note":"The margin is over Term SOFR for the applicable Interest Period.
